title.zh: Bitwise NEAR 现货 ETF 获美国上市批准并开始交易
title.en: Bitwise NEAR spot ETF wins U.S. listing approval and begins trading

current_state.zh: Bitwise NEAR ETF（NRR）已于 2026 年 9 月 29 日在纽交所 Arca 正式上市并开始交易，为美国首只现货 NEAR ETP，管理费 0.75%，并计划质押持仓以获取约 5% 的平均质押奖励；上线首日资产管理规模达 3600 万美元，净流入 3550 万美元，成交量为 1510 万美元。
current_state.en: Bitwise NEAR ETF (NRR) has officially listed and begun trading on NYSE Arca on September 29, 2026, as the first U.S. spot NEAR ETP with a 0.75% management fee and plans to stake its holdings for roughly 5% average staking yield; on its first day it reached $36 million in assets under management, $35.5 million in net inflows, and $15.1 million in trading volume.

updates.title_zh: Bitwise 的 NEAR ETF 通过 NYSE Arca 与 SEC 关卡，上市在即 - TradingView
updates.title_en: Bitwise’s NEAR ETF clears NYSE Arca and SEC hurdles, launch imminent - TradingView
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 TradingView 报道，Bitwise 的 NEAR 交易所交易基金（ETF）已通过 NYSE Arca 的上市要求以及 SEC 的监管关卡，上市时间被描述为“即将到来”。该产品此前一直被跟踪为一只瞄准 NEAR Protocol 的待批加密基金。

该批准为美国投资者通过交易所交易产品获得 NEAR 敞口打开了通道，此前 NEAR 在美国尚无现货 ETF 上市。这也延续了此前多只现货山寨币 ETF 依次通过 NYSE Arca 与 SEC 审核的模式。

Bitwise 在欧洲已有一只 NEAR 质押交易所交易产品——Bitwise NEAR Staking ETP（ISIN：DE000A4A5GV2），于 2025 年 6 月 26 日推出，注册地在德国，管理资产规模约 3500 万欧元。NYSE Arca 是由洲际交易所旗下 NYSE Group 拥有的全电子化交易所，在美国 ETP 交易量中占据最大份额。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitwise's spot NEAR ETF has cleared NYSE Arca listing and SEC regulatory requirements, with a launch described as imminent.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitwise's spot NEAR ETF has cleared NYSE Arca listing and SEC regulatory requirements, with a launch described as imminent.
updates.background_zh: NEAR Protocol 是一条采用权益证明（PoS）共识与分片架构的第一层区块链，由 Illia Polosukhin 和 Alexander Skidanov 于 2018 年创立，主网于 2020 年上线。它被设计为以太坊及其他一层网络的替代方案，面向可扩展的去中心化应用。在本次过关之前，Bitwise 的 NEAR 产品在 ETF 数据页面上被列为待批准的 Bitwise Near Strategy ETF。
updates.background_en: NEAR Protocol is a layer-1 blockchain that uses proof-of-stake consensus and a sharded architecture, founded in 2018 by Illia Polosukhin and Alexander Skidanov, with mainnet launching in 2020. It was designed as an alternative to Ethereum and other layer-1 networks for scalable decentralized applications. Bitwise's NEAR product was tracked on ETF data pages as the Bitwise Near Strategy ETF pending approval before this clearance.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若美国现货 NEAR ETF 正式挂牌，需求将通过授权参与人以及申购/赎回机制传导，把 ETF 资金流与各交易所的 NEAR 现货流动性连接起来；而 Bitwise 现有 NEAR 产品所涉及的质押功能，则指向可能的锁仓供应渠道。该过关消息也会影响市场对 NYSE Arca 其他待批山寨币 ETF 的情绪，但实际资金流影响的大小仍取决于产品是否真正上市及其接受度。
updates.market_impact_en: A listed US spot NEAR ETF would route demand through authorized participants and the creation/redemption process, linking ETF flows to NEAR spot liquidity across exchanges, and the staking features referenced in Bitwise's existing NEAR products point to a possible supply-lock channel. The clearance also feeds sentiment around other pending altcoin ETF filings at NYSE Arca, though the magnitude of any flow effect depends on actual launch and uptake.

updates.what_changed_zh: Bitwise NEAR ETF（代码 NRR）已于 2026 年 9 月 29 日在纽交所 Arca 正式上市交易，成为美国首只现货 NEAR ETP，计划内部质押持仓以获取约 5% 的平均质押奖励。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bitwise listed the Bitwise NEAR ETF (ticker NRR) on NYSE Arca on September 29, 2026, making it the first US spot NEAR ETP, with a 0.75% management fee and plans to stake the fund's NEAR holdings for roughly 5% average staking yield.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitwise listed the Bitwise NEAR ETF (ticker NRR) on NYSE Arca on September 29, 2026, making it the first US spot NEAR ETP, with a 0.75% management fee and plans to stake the fund's NEAR holdings for roughly 5% average staking yield.
updates.background_zh: NEAR 是一条一层区块链，2024 年将战略转向 AI，此后日益聚焦跨链基础设施与自主 AI 代理。Bitwise 表示，该网络的跨链交易协议 NEAR Intents 的交易量已从一年前的不足 10 亿美元升至逾 320 亿美元。据报道引用的 CoinGecko 数据，该代币过去一个月上涨约 167%，报约 4.94 美元。Bitwise 首席投资官 Matt Hougan 对 Cointelegraph 表示，公司认为 AI 代理是 NEAR 日益增长的应用场景。
updates.background_en: NEAR is a layer-1 blockchain that shifted its strategy toward AI in 2024 and has since emphasized cross-chain infrastructure and autonomous AI agents. Bitwise said activity on NEAR Intents, the network's cross-chain transaction protocol, has risen to more than $32 billion in volume from less than $1 billion a year ago. The token rallied about 167% over the past month to around $4.94, according to CoinGecko data cited in reports. Bitwise chief investment officer Matt Hougan told Cointelegraph the firm sees AI agents as a growing use case for NEAR.
updates.market_impact_zh: NRR 为美国券商账户提供了直接参与这一中型市值山寨币的现货渠道；计划中的基金内部质押意味着所持 NEAR 有一部分不处于自由流通中，并产生计入净值的协议奖励。此次上市也把“单一代币+质押”的 ETP 模式延伸至 NEAR，该类产品的资金流与折溢价表现可能与其现货市场走势出现分化。
updates.market_impact_en: NRR gives US brokerage accounts a direct spot channel into a mid-cap altcoin, and the planned in-fund staking means part of the held NEAR sits outside free circulation and earns protocol rewards that accrue to NAV. The listing also extends the model of single-asset altcoin ETPs with staking to NEAR, a segment whose flows and premium/discount behavior can diverge from the token's spot markets.
